CITY OF LA VERNE
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  Wednesday, January 10, 2024

1  Chairperson Simison called the meeting of the La Verne Planning
  Commission to order at 6:30 p.m.

2.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Commissioner Chang led the Pledge of Allegiance

3  ROLL CALL: Planning Commissioners present: Jason Simison, Thomas
  Allison, Keny Chang, and Erin Duffy. Advisory personnel present:
  Community Development Director Eric Scherer, City Attorney Scott Porter,
  Assistant Planner Parker Stringfellow, and Secretary Natalie Hiatt. Absent:
  Commissioner Jeremy Conrad.

4.  MINUTES - December 13, 2023

  It was moved by Commissioner Chang and seconded by Commissioner
  Duffy to approve the minutes of the Deeember 13, 2023 meeting. Motion
  carried by a 4-0 vote.

5.  PUBLIC COMMENT

  None

PUBLIC HEARINGS

6  CASE NO. 129-23CUP 1365 FOOTHILL BOULEVARD
  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT FOR WATER WINGS SWIM SCHOOL

  RESOLUTION NO. 1318

  A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF
  LA VERNE, COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES, STATE OF CALIFORNIA,
  APPROVING CASE NO. 129.23CUP TO ALLOW ESTABLISHMENT OF
  WATER WINGS, INDOOR SWIM FACILITY AT 1365 FOOTHILL
  BOULEVARD, AND AFFIRMING A CATEGORICAL EXEMPTION FROM
  THE CALIFORNIA ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT.

  Assistant Planner Parker Stringfellow presented his staff report. The
  applicant Stacey Brenner was present at the meeting.
 Planning Commission Minutes - January 10, 2024

  Chairperson Simison opened public comment. There were no comments
  Chairperson Simison closed public comment.

  The Commissioners asked if any complaints were received and asked
  questions regarding parking.

  Staff stated that no correspondence was received. Mr. Scherer stated that
  the pool will take up most of the space and due to the class size and type
  of business it's not expected to cause a parking shortage.

  It was moved by Commissioner Allison and seconded by Commissioner
  Chang to approve Resolution No. 1318. Motion carried by a 4-0 vote.

7  CASE NOS. 132.23CUP & 1M.23CUP - 1395 FOOTHILL BOULEVARD
  - CONDITIONAL USE PERMITS FOR HOTWORX FITNESS STUDIO &
  LATE.NIGHT HOURS

  RESOLUTION NOS. 1319 & 1320

  A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF
  LA VERNE, COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES, STATE OF CALIFORNIA,
  APPROVING CASE NO. 132-23CUP TO ALLOW THE OPERATION OF
  A FITNESS STUDIO AT 1395 FOOTHILL BOULEVARD, AND
  AFFIRMING A CATEGORICAL EXEMPTION FROM THE CALIFORNIA
  ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT.

  Assistant Planner Parker Stringfellow presented his staff report. The
  applicants Stella Pak and Stacey Brenner were present at the meeting.

  Chairperson Simison opened public comment. There were no comments
  Chairperson Simison closed public comment.

  The Commissioners had questions regarding security protocols and
  medical emergencies.

  Ms. Pak explained the reservation system and door access via the app and
  pin code access. The business wil! be monitored with security cameras and
  the customers will have an emergency pendant to wear during their
  workout. The pendant will alert authorities in the event of an emergency.

  It was moved by commissioner Allison and seconded by commissioner
  Duffy to approve Case No. 132-23CUP. Motion carried by a 4-0 vote.

  2
 Planning Commission Minutes - January 10, 2024

DIRECTOR COMMENTS

  Mr. Scherer invited the Commissioners to the Planning Commissioners
  Academy in March. He stated that an email was sent with the details and
  an R.S.V.P. is needed by the end of February.

  Mr. Scherer stated that no items are being tracked for the February Planning
  Commission meeting.

ADJOURNMENT

  The meeting was adjourned at 6:59 p.m. The next regular meeting of the
  Planning Commiss ion will  February 14,2024 at 6:30 p.m. in the
  Council Chambers,  La Verne,  91750
